scripts.dev: npm run buildc && npm run dev --workspace=@indigram/api
scripts.buildc: npm run build --workspace=@indigram/database && npm run build --workspace=@indigram/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@indigram/database && npm run typecheck --workspace=@indigram/api
scripts.predev:all: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@indigram/database
scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:down && npm run predev:all && docker compose up -d postgres redis minio && npm run db:migrate && docker compose up -d --build api && concurrently --kill-others --names web,worker --prefix-colors magenta,green "npm run dev --workspace=@indigram/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@indigram/worker"
